title: crambe scabra
intro: Crambe scabra, commonly known as Sea Holly, is a perennial plant species native to the Mediterranean region and other parts of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and infections. The therapeutic actions of Crambe scabra include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
